dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Paloma arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. During intake, she was observed to growl and snap at the handler when they placed her in kennel. While in care, Paloma has remained fearful and allows limited handling. Upon contact, she has been observed to head whip and lip lick. Due to the detailed behavopr we recommend an adult only home.
dog.name: Paloma
